newsitem.title: USA: Falcon Building Q4 net up on higher sales.
newsitem.headline: Falcon Building Q4 net up on higher sales.

text.p: Falcon Building Products Inc said Thursday strong demand for its products helped earnings climb significantly in the fourth quarter.

The company reported net income of $8.5 million, or $0.42 a share, in the quarter ended December 31, compared to $5.6 million, or $0.28 a share, in the corresponding period in 1995. Revenues climbed to $157.7 million from $121.8 million.
As previously announced, Falcon Building Products said its board is exploring several strategic alternatives, including the sale of the company in its entirety.
The company makes engineered building products.
Its shares closed up 1/4 Thursday at 15-1/8.
